defect.summary: Discovery looked only for UnrealEditor.exe, the UE5 name. CARLA 0.9.x targets UE4.26, whose Windows editor is Engine/Binaries/Win64/UE4Editor.exe, so a complete UE4.26 install was reported missing.
defect.secondary_defect: Both tools used next(iter((a, b)), None), which yields only the first element of the tuple, so one absent first candidate silently masked every later candidate.

fix.ue5_retained: deliberately: the names differ, so UE5 detection is kept as a separate family
fix.search: every candidate name in every Engine/Binaries/<platform> subdirectory, plus the root itself

separate_receipt_states.UE_ENGINE_EDITOR_PRESENT: evidenced by locating an editor binary; nothing else inferred
separate_receipt_states.CARLA_PROJECT_COMPILED: evidenced by compiled project artifacts (UnrealEditor-Carla.dll/.so, .target); independent of the server binary
separate_receipt_states.CARLA_SERVER_BINARY_PRESENT: evidenced by locating a CarlaUE4 server binary; independent of the editor
separate_receipt_states.CARLA_RPC_RESPONSIVE: requires an actual RPC response; a listening port is explicitly not accepted as evidence
separate_receipt_states.MAP_PACKAGE_COOKED: evidenced by cooked content directories; explicitly not runtime loadability
separate_receipt_states.MAP_RUNTIME_LOADABLE: requires starting a server and loading the map
separate_receipt_states.unknown_policy: unknown remains unknown; no state is derived from another

tests.isolation: all filesystem trees built under tmp_path; nothing written outside the test temp area
